name: Arizona Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
organization: Arizona DES Division of Aging and Adult Services
description: Ombudsmen advocate for residents of nursing homes and assisted living facilities and help resolve complaints about care. Local ombudsman programs run through each Area Agency on Aging region.
next_step: Call the county’s Area Agency on Aging and ask for the long-term-care ombudsman, or call the state ombudsman office. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.

source_evidence.scope: State office phone, DES program page and regional programs by Area Agency on Aging; search excerpt.

name: VA medical centers serving Arizona
description: Three VA health care systems serve Arizona: Phoenix VA Health Care System, Carl T. Hayden VA Medical Center (602-277-5551); Southern Arizona VA Health Care System, Tucson (520-792-1450); and Northern Arizona VA Health Care System, Bob Stump VA Medical Center, Prescott (928-445-4860). Each runs clinics across its area.
next_step: Use VA’s facility locator with your ZIP code to find the closest clinic and its medical center. Not enrolled yet? Call 877-222-8387 or ask an ADVS Veteran Benefits Counselor for help applying.
constraints: VA does not publish county lists for these systems, so this card does not assign counties. Your VA care team may be at a different clinic or system; follow what VA tells you.
